'''Abby's Planchette''' is a [[Weapons#Dagger|dagger weapon]] that can be purchased from [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|Abigail's shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|70|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s.

==Trivia==
* [[Abigail]]'s planchette is referred to in her [[Abigail#Eight Hearts|8-heart event]].
